description: This script measures execution time of a command in a Unix-like environment, utilizing high-resolution timers and system calls to obtain precise timing information before and after command execution, then outputs timing and resource usage details.

methods.name: gettime
methods.description: Retrieves the current time with high resolution, using Time::HiRes::gettimeofday if available, otherwise falling back to syscall with sys/time.h, returning seconds and microseconds.
